notes: Every reference is a picture (no live page), so type and colour are measured with measure.mjs --lines and fonts.mjs --shape; raw readings in .longbeard/design/direction/measure/<name>.json. Faces were set beside their reference in .longbeard/design/direction/faces.jpg and the one plainly of its kind taken.

Presentation frames: 03, 04, 05 and 08 are mock-ups on a backdrop; measure.mjs read the backdrop as the ground for 03 (#dddddd), 04 (#2a2a2a) and 05 (#e1e3e2). The page grounds below are read by eye inside the frame.
Light only (design brief): 08-dark-arches' deep-green page and 04-still-life's black photo half are not borrowable as page grounds; the references stay.
Motion is recorded only for the lead and for references a pick is built on; every reference is a still, so motion is 'not seen' throughout.

references.name: 01-arch-poster

likes.what: the photo in a tall arch with the text set around it
likes.why: it frames one thing and makes the page feel like a calm room

references.concept: One picture held in a tall arch at the centre of an almost empty stone-coloured page; every word is set around it in one warm terracotta, so the page reads as a calm room with one window.
references.move: a photo in a tall round-topped arch, centred, with the words set around it: a paragraph above, vertical lines at both sides, small blocks below
references.layout: Portrait poster (1650 x 2445). Margins about 9% each side. A centred paragraph of three lines across the top (box x 9-88%, y 6-14%), centred. The arch: x 31-71% (40% of the width), y 21-66% (45% of the height), round top, square bottom, no border. Vertical text, rotated, at x 14% (reading down) and x 85% (reading up), centred on the arch's height. Foot: three small blocks at y 85-94%: left (hours) at x 14-26%, a ring with the name at the centre x 43-57%, right (address) at x 72-90%, all centred text. 81% of the page is empty ground. Nothing overlaps or runs off. At 1440 wide (landscape) the arch keeps 40% of the height share and the surround keeps its four sides: words above, both sides vertical, small blocks below.

display.note: a geometric sans with loose tracking; fonts.mjs's top three (Sono, Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, Trispace) are monospaced, plainly not its kind, because the measured width (0.64) includes the tracking. Jost read by eye as the nearest of its kind.

mark.face: a light high-contrast serif in caps inside a thin ring

references.spacing: At 1440: margin about 130px; the paragraph sits about 90px from the top; about 120px between the paragraph and the arch; the vertical lines sit about 140px clear of the arch; the foot blocks sit about 110px below the arch with 4px between their lines.
references.pictures: One photograph, toned warm sepia (a single warm hue, no greys), cropped to a tall round-topped arch, about 18% of the page; a calm, symmetrical subject with depth.

slots.note: the 'headline' here is a calm paragraph, not a big title; the vertical lines are the name and the date

devices: thin terracotta ring holding the name

measured.radius: arch: full semicircle on top, 0 at the foot

references.name: 03-dot-editorial

likes.what: the orange disc as the only button
likes.why: the one spot of contrast on a quiet page, so the eye goes straight to it

likes.what: the black-and-white photos at different heights
likes.why: they feel like a contact sheet, unposed

references.concept: A quiet off-white page with a light serif name and black-and-white photos scattered at staggered heights; the only colour is an orange disc that is the button.
references.move: an orange disc, the only colour on the page, as the button, its label running out past its edge
references.layout: Page inside a frame (page x 8-92%, y 18-82% of the shot). Within the page: logotype two lines top-left (x 6%, y 6%); menu lines top-right. The name at x 6-30%, y 30-40%. The disc under it at x 6-12% (about 6% of page width, 100px at 1440), its label starting inside and running past its right edge. Photos: three, black and white, at staggered heights: x 30-50% (y 47-94%), x 54-81% (y 12-80%), x 85-100% runs off the right edge (y 33-67%). Small links bottom-right; scroll arrows bottom-left. About 54% empty.
references.spacing: At 1440: page margin about 95px; the disc sits about 60px under the name; small text 12-14px; photos about 50px apart, never aligned at top or bottom.
references.pictures: Three black-and-white photographs, unposed, at different sizes and heights, the last cropped by the page edge; square corners, no frame.
devices: filled orange disc as the button, label overrunning it
scroll arrows with a thin circle

references.name: 04-still-life

likes.what: the big orange disc the tall condensed title crosses
likes.why: the title and the shape fight a little, which makes it alive

likes.what: the title broken top and bottom

references.concept: A split page: a dark still life of fruit on the left half, and on the right a warm grey panel where a big orange disc sits between a tall condensed serif title broken into a top line and a bottom line that cross it.
references.move: a tall condensed serif title split into a top and a bottom line, both crossing a big orange disc
references.layout: Page inside a frame (page x 8-92%, y 18-82%). Left half (x 0-50% of page): one photograph full bleed, dark ground. Right half: a warm grey panel. Small nav caps top-right. Title line 1 at y 7-25% of page, x 52-80%; the disc centred about x 67%, y 27-75%, diameter about 27% of page width (390px at 1440); title lines 2-3 at y 70-97% of page, x 52-86%, crossing the bottom of the disc. Tiny uppercase notes (6-7px measured, read as 9-10px at 1440) scattered in the right margin, x 84-90%. About 57% empty in the panel.

display.note: fonts.mjs: nothing close (2.13); Instrument Serif set beside it is plainly its kind (tall, condensed, high-contrast)

references.spacing: At 1440: the title's lines touch the disc; the small notes sit in a narrow right column about 60px from the edge; the panel's margin about 20px at the title (it nearly touches the seam).

more.photo half: #111111 (dark still life; not a page ground: light only)

references.pictures: One still-life photograph of food on a plain cloth against black, soft focus at the back, filling half the page.
devices: big filled orange disc behind the title
title broken into top and bottom lines
split page: photo half and panel half
tiny uppercase notes in the margin

references.name: 05-orange-block

likes.what: the photo straddling the seam between the light panel and the dark band

likes.why: a hard edge of colour at the side, not in the middle of things

references.concept: A light panel for the words, a dark band and a red strip at the right; one toned portrait sits across the seam between the light and the dark, binding them.
references.move: a photo straddling the seam between a light panel and a dark band, with a red strip at the far edge
references.layout: Page inside a frame (page x 8-92%, y 26-73%). Light panel x 0-57%; dark band x 57-86%; red strip x 86-100%, full height. The photo: x 47-79%, y 13-88%, so about a third of it is over the light panel. Breadcrumb top-left (x 6%, y 10%); name at x 6-16%, y 38-45%; two lines of body under it (y 49-52%); two dots and 'Next' at the bottom (y 85%). Social links rotated in the strip. About 75% empty in the light panel.
references.spacing: At 1440: panel margin about 80px; body 20px under the name; the dots and 'Next' about 100px from the bottom.
references.pictures: One portrait, duotoned rust-on-black, tall, square corners, straddling the seam.
devices: full-height red strip at the edge

references.name: 08-dark-arches

likes.what: the thin elegant serif in gold on deep green
likes.why: it feels slow and crafted, like a shop sign

references.brief: light only: the deep-green page is not borrowed; the like is carried by its role: the thin high-contrast serif and the gold, on a light ground
references.concept: A deep green page set in a thin, high-contrast serif in cream and gold, with arched photographs and a slow word band along the foot: a painted shop sign.
references.move: a thin, high-contrast serif in cream and gold, set large and slow
references.layout: Page inside a frame (page x 5-95%, y 7-100%). Ring logo top-left; centred nav; outlined bag button top-right. Headline 'Calm Ritual' two lines at x 12-32%, y 26-46%. A body line under it. Arched photo centre x 36-64%, y 26-56%, a framed panel below it. Right column: a small round photo, a gold word, 'Next' with a two-line title over a second arched photo that runs off the right edge. Word band with diamonds along the foot (y 96%). About 65% empty.

display.note: fonts.mjs: nothing close (2.29); Kalnia 200 set beside it is the nearest of its kind (thin, high contrast)

references.spacing: At 1440: margin about 95px; headline lines 0.95 apart; body 30px under the headline; word band 20px from the foot.

palette.borrowable: the gold #c09464 and the cream ink as type colours only; the green ground is a dark page and is not borrowed (light only)

references.pictures: Photographs in round-topped arches and a circle, muted, soft, one per zone; one runs off the right edge.
devices: word band with diamonds at the foot

references.name: 09-teal-window

likes.what: the rounded photo window with small mono text in its four corners
likes.why: the picture is the page, and the text only labels it

references.concept: A single photograph in a rounded window at the centre of a pale page, with small spaced uppercase mono labels at the four corners and the two sides: the picture is the page, the text only labels it.
references.move: a rounded photo window at the centre, small spaced mono labels in its four corners
references.layout: Portrait poster (1800 x 2250). Margin about 7% each side. Window centred x 21-79% (58% of the width), y 19-70%, corner radius about 9% of its width. Six label blocks of two or three lines: top-left (x 7%, y 5%), top-right (right-aligned to x 93%), mid-left and mid-right on the window's centre line (overlapping its edge), bottom-left and bottom-right (y 81-84%). About 66% empty.

display.note: every text is the same size: there is no title

references.spacing: At 1440: margin about 100px; labels align to the margin; the mid labels sit on the window's centre line and run into it.
references.pictures: One photograph, as shot, warm and soft, in a rounded rectangle window, about a third of the page.

finish.css: a very faint radial vignette on the ground: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 45%, #dfe6e8 0%, #d2dadd 100%)

devices: label blocks at the four corners and two sides

references.name: 10-arch-portrait

likes.what: the headline running over the arch's edge

references.concept: A warm cream page where a tall arched photograph sits left of centre and a large thin high-contrast serif headline starts over the arch's right edge and runs out into the page, with a paragraph and side portraits around it.
references.move: a big thin high-contrast serif headline that starts over the arched photo's edge and runs out across the page
references.layout: Landscape (1800 x 1200). Ring monogram top-left (x 6-16%, y 6-20%). Date box top-right (x 77-100%, y 0-16%) with hairline rules. Arch x 20-48%, y 11-86%, round top. Headline two lines at x 43-85%, y 28-50%, its first letters over the arch. A feather drawing above (x 62%, y 20%). Paragraph x 52-82%, y 58-69%. Vertical small text at x 17%. Portrait crops running off both edges: left x 0-10% (y 32-72%), right x 86-100% (y 32-72%). A footer row with hairline rules at y 92-100%: 'About' left, two labels right. About 67% empty.

display.note: fonts.mjs: nothing close (2.67); Prata set beside it is plainly a high-contrast didone of its kind

references.spacing: At 1440: margin about 80px; the headline overlaps the arch by about 70px; paragraph 60px under the headline; footer 90px tall with a hairline above.
references.pictures: One photograph in a tall round-topped arch, as shot, soft and airy; two narrow portrait crops running off the left and right edges.
devices: ring of text around a monogram
